newsitem.title: USA: FRUIT OF THE LOOM CUTS 1,480 JOBS IN KY..
newsitem.headline: FRUIT OF THE LOOM CUTS 1,480 JOBS IN KY..

text.p: Fruit of the Loom Inc said Thursday it is eliminating 1,480 sewing and garment assembly jobs at its Campbellsville, Ky., textile facility due to intense competition in the textile and apparel business.

The company expects to take a charge against earnings in a range of $14 million to $22 million pretax in the second half of the year to cover the costs of severance and downsizing, Fruit of the Loom spokesman Mark Steinkrauss said in a telephone interview from the company's central Kentucky plant.
